functions.does: The handlebars steer: the whole front end, with its two fork legs, both front wheels, the yellow mudguards and the headlight, turns on a 4-long axle pushed down through the frame's motorcycle steering head.
functions.source: book: front sub-steps 1-6 (pages 9-11: mudguards, fork legs and handlebars), step 12 (the 4-long axle through the steering head), step 13 (wheels)

functions.does: The four wheels roll freely, each on its own axle pin; there's no drive.
functions.source: book: steps 8 (rear axle pins) and 13, front sub-step 6
